roles.K6F: the KCs, carrying (set K's GCaMP6f flies)
roles.K1020: 2022-10-20: partner (7) as a KC fly, and described as an APL fly; in no carrying set
roles.L: APL, carrying, with S: E101's c_responses.csv, group 'L', not read again
roles.H: beside (A5): E100's b_per_stimulus.csv, set H, label_unsure False, not read again

L.first_presentation: first_two (E101 saved no single first presentation)

response.table: Yang's `<stem>_<tag>_roi_peak_dff.csv`, column roi_peak_dff, one row per presentation in the yaml's odor_stim_seq order (rows and pins must match the yaml's, else the recording has no value)
response.carrying: order_matched: each presentation minus the mean of the solvent-only blocks' presentations at the same position in the block (E100's `presentation_readings`); a stimulus's response the mean over its presentations (both passes where a run has two); no value in a run without a solvent-only block
response.block_solvent: minus_block: each presentation minus its own block's solvent presentation(s)
response.first_presentation: the order-matched value of the stimulus's first presentation (its first block)
response.interpolation: E98's `value_at` on log10 concentration inside a recording's imaged range; outside it the nearest end within one log unit, inclusive

fly.recordings: all planes; a fly's falls are the mean of its recordings' natural-log falls (both responses above min_response)
fly.value: the geometric mean over flies (the arithmetic mean for the 10^-7 / 10^-3 falls, WEAK_FALL_IDS, and for X3's responses)

q.definition: APL's fall over the KCs' (geometric means over flies)
q.interval: joint bootstrap: n_boot draws, each resampling both sets' flies with replacement; the 5th and 95th percentiles

split_rule.definition: two sets differ on a fall if fewer than share of the splits of all their flies into sets of the same sizes give a difference of mean log falls at least as large (absolute; E98's `pulse_permutation`)

x1.rule: 'APL steeper' if at least min_falls of G1 to G3 are held APL steeper and none KCs steeper; 'one function' if at least min_falls are held one function and none steeper either way; otherwise not decided

held.plane: recordings.csv's plane_depth_um (Yang's yaml / date note), the Experiment.xml's piezo position where it has none; partner (4) leaves out PLANE_UNCERTAIN (yaml and xml disagree)
held.rule: a class counts only if the carrying reading and every partner give it; partner (6) is one reading per KC fly left out, each of which must give it

x2.level: the window mean minus the blank's (same wiring and condition)
x2.numerator: paa at 10^-5 under each of the three sessions' estimates
x2.rule: per wiring E98's `classify` of the model's ratio set (the three claw versions through E98's indicator family) against set K's G1 interval (inside, flatter, steeper); a class takes min_wirings of 8; over the estimates E100's rule (inside if inside under any; flatter or steeper only if so under all)

x3.rule: an odor's KC response at 10^-7 (carrying reading) is above the solvent's if it is positive in at least min_flies of the 5 KC flies; X3 holds if so for at least min_odors of paa, pa and ms

a5.rule: K7F against set H by the same rules (described; changes no class)

note: Part A's definitions, written by part 0 before any response table of set K was opened. `require_part_a` refuses to open set K's tables until this file is committed, its sha256 is its definitions' and they equal the module's `part_a_definitions()`.
